comingLast.roast: done on 17 - every finisher from here is must-watch television
still out there on 13 - the clubhouse is doing his maths for him
2 points from escape - Rava has stopped watching his own card
escape number: 2. holes remaining: 5. belief in the clubhouse: modest.
pace of 1.3 - the blue balls have started their walk to the bar
1 from 6 - do it for the car keys
2 points of daylight - barely enough to read by
his lead over Rava is 2 - a strong gust could move it
above Rava by 2 - close enough to hear the engraver
the blue balls are 4 points away and gaining slowly
